title: seeded design-conformance break caught (a governing DINV/Decision violated)
negative_example: a violation hidden behind a correct-looking abstraction — a helper with a sensible name whose body crosses the partition line the design declares load-bearing.

legs.charter: Task: add the store's flush path. Governing design DINV-4: the engine core imports NO adapter package; a port is an interface defined on the consumer (engine) side and adapters implement it in their own package. The boundary is load-bearing.

expected_catch.message: DINV-4 forbids the engine core importing an adapter package; internal/engine/flush.go now imports internal/adapter/githubstore and calls it directly, crossing the port boundary the design declares load-bearing.
